# freightdatajp

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/UchidaMizuki/freightdatajp/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/UchidaMizuki/freightdatajp/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

freightdatajp provides ready-to-use interregional freight flow data for Japan, starting with the interprefectural tables (都道府県間流動表) of the Net Freight Flow Census (全国貨物純流動調査, the logistics census) for 2005, 2010, 2015, and 2021.

The tables are built from the published workbooks by [targets](https://docs.ropensci.org/targets/) pipelines bundled with the package. The first call for a year downloads the sources and builds the tables; later calls read them from the cache managed by [tarchives](https://github.com/UchidaMizuki/tarchives).

## Installation

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("UchidaMizuki/freightdatajp")
```

## Usage

Each function takes the survey year. `logistics_census_flow_get()` also takes the breakdown of the published table to return, here the representative transport mode:

```{r}
#| label: flow
library(freightdatajp)

logistics_census_flow_get(2021, by = "mode")
```

Origins and destinations are two-digit prefecture codes (`"01"` to `"47"`), whose names and representative points (population centroids) are in the zone table:

```{r}
#| label: zone
logistics_census_zone_get(2021)
```

The other tables are:

```{r}
#| label: other
#| eval: false
# Weight (t) between prefectures, by the breakdown of a published table
logistics_census_flow_get(2021, by = "commodity")
logistics_census_flow_get(2021, by = "commodity_class") # with n_shipments
logistics_census_flow_get(2021, by = c("mode", "expressway"))
logistics_census_flow_get(2021, by = c("mode", "commodity_class"))

# Travel time (h per shipment) by mode
logistics_census_time_get(2021)

# Freight rate (yen per tonne-km) by mode and commodity class
logistics_census_freight_rate_get(2021)
```

Every year returns the same columns, types, and units, so tables for several years can be bound together.
